provider: Statistics Netherlands / Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS)
api_version: CBS StatLine OData 3 exact Dutch table 85772NED; output-price index for new dwellings 2021=100; official Modified 2026-09-30

request_contract.parameter_rules: Six EXACT manually opt-in anonymous HTTPS GET URLs, not arbitrary OData queries. TableInfos?$top=1; TypedDataSet?$top=1; Perioden?$top=1; DataProperties?$top=6; TypedDataSet?$filter=Perioden%20eq%20%272026KW02%27&$top=1; Perioden?$filter=Key%20eq%20%272026KW02%27&$top=1. No caller inputs, pagination, path/host/query substitution, redirects, retries, credentials, bulk mirrors, schedule, feed endpoints or other CBS tables. Each request <=16384 bytes and at most six aggregate public records, far below CBS standard 10000-cell limit.

response_contract.format: Six strict UTF-8 CBS OData 3 JSON bodies, one TableInfos, six DataProperties, one definitive 2018KW01 Perioden, one preliminary 2026KW02 Perioden, one source first numeric row and one fixed latest-quarter numeric row; only typed summaries and per ORIGINAL response SHA-256 receipts can leave memory. No provider original body persisted or logged.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: CBS new dwelling OUTPUT construction price index base 2021=100, distinct from the 85728NED monthly INPUT-price index. This index includes contractor overhead and profit/risk but excludes land and developer/broker costs. VAT-inclusive and VAT-exclusive 2021=100 indices are explicitly separate CBS topic dimensions. Source 2018KW01 first official index=87.7 both variants (definitive); 2026KW02=133.4 both, 4.4% year-on-year, explicitly provisional. December 2025 publisher methodology correction revised 2022+ output indices up to 7.6 index points; no conflation of historical vintages. Index points are dimensionless, NOT full replacement cost in euros, insured building TIV, individual property values, hazards, stochastic losses or premiums.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: CBS StatLine OData standard direct-use service permits automated limited public data use (max 10000 cells per request). This single explicitly manually opted-in test makes only six <=6-row requests; no recurring polling, bulk download, unattended crawl or API rate/usage expansion.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: CBS table source metadata last Modified 2026-09-30T02:00:00 and original first/2026Q2 rows were observed on 2026-11-13. The CBS current-version dataset can be revised; freeze original response SHA256 and bytes per request, exact final URL, UTC, direct HTTP 200, no redirect; fail closed on schema, historical numeric, latest quarter or definitive-vs-preliminary status changes. December 2025 methodology correction makes earlier releases non-comparable without vintage reconciliation. Never assert all 2018-2026 quarters or entire asset hashes from six rows.

rights_and_policy.notes: Official Dutch government CBS 85772NED catalogue explicitly CC BY 4.0, public API; CBS permits automated processing with 10000 cells/request standard API. Commercial derivative analysis with CBS attribution, change disclosure and no CBS endorsement is permitted for this exact public aggregated table. No rights for unrelated content, raw source-byte publication, insurer portfolio data or all CBS datasets are assumed. This legal product-use allowance is not scientific model admission or blanket bulk automation authorization.
